people.name: Gezer
people.line: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.

people.name: Hushathites
people.line: A clan or family known for their warriors.

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Rapha
people.line: Ancestor of Philistine giants; his descendants fought against David's warriors.

people.name: Saph
people.line: Philistine giant killed by Sibbechai the Hushathite

people.name: Sibbecai
people.line: One of David's mighty men, a Hushathite.

translations.web: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
translations.bsb: Some time later at Gob, there was another battle with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, a descendant of Rapha.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.
translations.asv: And it came to pass after this, that there was again war with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
